bare_silicate_limit_gate.bare_control_policy: Zero mantle uses a true bare template; epsilon is solely a limiting test.
bare_silicate_limit_gate.comparison: actual Mie 1 1 bare silicate versus Mie 2 2 coated with f_ice=1e-6 at matched total mass and outer size convention
bare_silicate_limit_gate.flux_gate: For every anchor, abs(mean paired fractional difference)+two-sided 95% uncertainty half-width <= 0.01; use five independent paired-seed differences and state interval assumptions.
bare_silicate_limit_gate.opacity_rule: For each of kappa_abs, kappa_sca and kappa_ext on the declared shared wavelength grid, require abs(coated-bare) <= max(0.001*abs(bare), 1e-6*max(abs(bare))). Record which wavelengths use the absolute floor. An identically zero reference requires exact zero or a separately declared physical absolute tolerance; nonfinite values fail. Compare g only where scattering is nonzero, recording undefined cases.

baseline_ice_definition.mass_parameter: total envelope dust mass including ice
baseline_ice_definition.quantity: fraction of total solid grain volume

external_prior_scenarios: inclination, luminosity and envelope mass fixed
conditional_inference.gate: Local covariance-aware matched responses, nuisance profiling, injection/recovery with held-out direct simulations and expanded boundaries before intervals.
conditional_inference.scope: Thirty-two baseline models and twenty-four material cases are response experiments, not comprehensive nuisance marginalization.

data_contract.centre_policy: Model each existing extraction at its actual centre, or freeze a common-centre re-extraction before joint use. Offset matters for the 1-arcsec continuum alone as well.
data_contract.h2o_rule: Convert node lambda_F_lambda to Fnu before frozen LSF and six-support continuum; apply to observations and models identically; no flux/tau double counting.

distance_policy: Scale model flux and angular aperture mapping together; observed fluxes are not distance-rescaled.

full_spectrum_operator_gate.closure: Aperture and total flux require compatible estimators; validate Method-2 closure and total-flux field of view. Finite-image totals cannot silently replace infinite-aperture totals.
full_spectrum_operator_gate.interpolation: Measure aperture correction at training wavelengths and held-out direct images within every accepted window/background class, including silicate wings/core and NIR slopes. No interpolation over untested features or outside support.
full_spectrum_operator_gate.opacity: Generate kappa_abs, kappa_sca, kappa_ext and g for every exact material/size/mixing hypothesis; bulk k-ratio is insufficient.
full_spectrum_operator_gate.operator_error_rule: These are provisional upper bounds, to be tightened if needed to remain below the window uncertainty and one third of a claimed physical contrast. Validate the frozen R100-bin/window measurement as well as dense model quadrature; method closure requires its own measured allocation.
full_spectrum_operator_gate.quadrature: Three-node versus five-node and dense/direct integrals per window; accept only below stated operator-error budget, otherwise increase nodes/direct images.
full_spectrum_operator_gate.requirement: Explicit dense SED stage, wavelength grid, transfer-method identity and benchmarked cost; preserve fresh temperature and executable provenance.

material_pilot.shape_attribution_limit: Coated versus disjoint DHS changes mixing topology and shape simultaneously; cannot attribute the difference solely to material or shape.
material_pilot.size_policy: Document outer radius for coated grains and radius convention for each disjoint species before template acceptance.
material_pilot.survival_policy: Uniform ice surrogate only; temperature-dependent survival not implemented. No physical abundance inference without survival audit.
material_pilot.temperature_policy: Fresh equilibrium for every changed dust hypothesis; no reuse across material, mixing, fraction or seed changes.

numerical_gate.budget_change_acceptance: For paired fractional 512k-to-2.048M changes, require abs(mean)+two-sided 95% uncertainty half-width <= 0.01 at every probe; an unresolved bound is not a pass.
numerical_gate.case_selection: Nominal 50 and 70 degree controls; fixed before fitting and repeated at both photon budgets.
numerical_gate.report: Individual seed fluxes, sample SD and its uncertainty, two-budget mean differences, and uncertainties of physical contrasts; matched seed labels are not assumed to guarantee variance cancellation.
numerical_gate.response_relative_target: Numerical uncertainty below one third of each claimed physical contrast; escalate packets/cases if unmet.
numerical_gate.scatter_acceptance: At the proposed production packet count, require the upper end of the two-sided 95% Gaussian SD interval divided by the seed mean to be <= 0.01 at every probed case/wavelength; otherwise increase fidelity or report inconclusive. State distribution assumptions.
numerical_gate.scope: Does not establish resolution convergence or guarantee all other models/wavelengths.

optical_coverage_gate.requirement: Source and hash a physically justified H2O30K extension across the full heating/cooling wavelength grid, including both short and long unsupported tails; document joins and any extrapolation sensitivity before production.

resources_proposed.photon_budget_status: conditional on numerical gate; increase if target fails

response_coverage.inference: Coverage diagnostic only. Global linear regression has large residuals, is scale-dependent and lacks an ice axis; no number of identifiable directions is asserted.

selection_rule: Eight fixed physical contrast families at four inclinations, selected by coverage before any new fit; material pilot backgrounds fixed in advance.

stage3_material.formula: 24*(85 H2O role nodes + 6 NIRSpec + 6 MIRI bands*nodes)

status: design and local template checks complete; numerical, operator and material gates pending

uncertainty_policy.absolute_scale_policy: Separate unresolved nuisance; profile or constrain explicitly before claiming an absolute likelihood.
uncertainty_policy.block_rule: Report NIRSpec continuum, primary MIRI broad bands and H2O separately. No implicit joint scalar. A joint likelihood requires declared cross-calibration/covariance and no double counting.
uncertainty_policy.gain_interpretation: Assumed sensitivity scales informed by adjacent overlaps, not measured independent subband uncertainties.
uncertainty_policy.legacy_15_percent: Affected diagonal diagnostic chi-square only; old regional log-RMS rankings did not use errors.
uncertainty_policy.legacy_region_rule: Old score sqrt(mean_regions(mean_anchors(log10(model/observed)^2))); MIRI occupied three of six regions. New bins do not become new equally weighted regions automatically.
uncertainty_policy.structure: Measured within-bin structure is a provisional window term including real signal, not a calibrated artifact variance; no sqrt(N) reduction.
